items.information:
**PORTUGUESE**
A competição é reconhecida pela Associação Mundial de Cubo Mágico (WCA) e os resultados farão parte dos rankings oficiais.
Teremos premiações (medalhas) para os três primeiros colocados de cada modalidade.
Contamos com a colaboração de TODOS para tornar a competição mais fluida. Portanto, quando solicitado, prontifique-se para ser juiz, embaralhador ou runner.

**ENGLISH**
The competitions is aknowledged by the World Cube Association (WCA) and the results will be ranked officially.
There will be prizes (medals) for the first three best results in each event.
We count on EVERYBODY's collaboration to make this competition more fluid. Therefore, when asked, please be ready to be a judge, scrambler or runner.

items.name: Please Be Quiet WPI Fall 2019

venue.name: [Worcester Polytechnic Institute](https://www.wpi.edu/)
venue.address: 100 Institute Road, Worcester, Massachusetts, United States

items.information:
3x3x3 Fewest Moves is the main event of this competition!

This is a quiet events competition. We will NOT be holding usual events like 3x3. If you are a new competitor or looking for more normal events, this probably isn't for you, and you may want to check out other local competitions. Spectators may attend for free, but you are likely to get bored very quickly as the events held are quite slow.

The competition will be held in Salisbury Labs 115 (SL 115), this building is across the fountain from the campus center. Parking can be found in any of the visitors lots on Institute Rd or on Boynton St. This is the room that Please Be Quiet WPI Spring 2019 happened in.
